note: Measured output of one PDF-to-Markdown converter (pdfmdtools.com, 17 September 2026) against the corpus in tests/. Output strings are verbatim. A different converter will produce different results — that is the point of the corpus. Field 'status' is the string the tool reported; 'output' is what it wrote to the output box.

## Compressed Stream Document

The content stream of this page is FlateDecode-compressed,
which is what almost every real PDF in the world uses.

## Key findings
- Expansion happens before parsing, so results should match.
- A parser that mishandles the filter fails here and nowhere else.
